mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_attempt_log (exam_id, subject_id, subject_name, exam_type, year, score, total_count, elapsed_seconds) VALUES (#{examId}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectName}, #{examType}, #{year}, #{score}, #{totalCount}, #{elapsedSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(submitted_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM exam_attempt_log WHERE submitted_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(submitted_at) ORDER BY DATE(submitted_at)

SELECT subject_id AS subject_id, subject_name AS subject_name, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count, COALESCE(AVG(score::float8 / NULLIF(total_count, 0)), 0) AS average_accuracy FROM exam_attempt_log GROUP BY subject_id, subject_name ORDER BY attempt_count DESC, subject_name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT exam_id AS exam_id, subject_name AS subject_name, exam_type AS exam_type, year AS year, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM exam_attempt_log GROUP BY exam_id, subject_name, exam_type, year ORDER BY attempt_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subject WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam WHERE use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT e.year || '년도 ' || s.subject_name || ' ' || CASE e.exam_type WHEN 'ATTENDANCE' THEN '출석대체시험' WHEN 'FINAL' THEN '기말시험' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN '계절학기시험' ELSE e.exam_type END FROM exam e JOIN subject s ON s.id = e.subject_id WHERE e.use_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.id) ORDER BY e.year DESC LIMIT 20
